methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 12 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 20.5x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

data.narrative:
Groq is a private-stage semiconductor company that has raised $3.54B to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector comprises 12 same-sector peers, including 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers such as Cerebras, Credo Semiconductor, SambaNova Systems, Etched, and Ayar Labs.

Two standard valuation methodologies were evaluated. Peer-Median analysis proved inapplicable: while 12 same-sector peers exist, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier yielded fewer than three datapoints in any subset, falling short of the minimum threshold for reliable median construction. Public-Comp Anchoring was similarly unavailable because Groq's revenue is not disclosed; the semiconductor sector median P/S ratio of 20.5x across the three public comps cannot be applied without the target's top-line figure.

The absence of sufficient narrow-peer multiples and lack of disclosed revenue preclude triangulation via these methods. Valuation support must therefore derive from alternative approaches—such as DCF analysis (if forward guidance were available), venture round precedent (prior tranches at documented prices), or strategic revenue/growth milestones tied to capital deployment. Without quantitative anchors from peer multiples or revenue data, any valuation range would rest on non-public information or forward assumptions not contained in this dataset. Further disclosure or alternative data would be required to establish a defensible valuation range.
